Class BrowserStackAppPlatform

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.driver.internal.BrowserStackAppPlatform
public final class BrowserStackAppPlatform extends Object
Checks that a native BrowserStack app matches targetOperatingSystem before a session starts. A local path is classified from its file name (.apk or .aab is ANDROID, .ipa is IOS). A bs:// id is classified from the app name or filename, which the caller supplies or lookupAppName(String, String, String) reads from recent apps. Credentials and the full id are never put in the failure message. -DbrowserStack.appUrl remains the property that selects the app; this class does not read a second secret.

    • platformFromName

      public static String platformFromName(String name)
      Classifies a native app from the file name, ignoring earlier path segments and a query string.
      Parameters:
      name - file name, URL, or BrowserStack app name
      Returns:
      ANDROID, IOS, or blank when the name has no known app suffix

    • isMobileTarget

      public static boolean isMobileTarget(String targetOperatingSystem)
      Reports whether the configured target is a mobile operating system.
      Parameters:
      targetOperatingSystem - configured targetOperatingSystem
      Returns:
      true when the target is Android or iOS

    • requireMatch

      public static void requireMatch(String appReference, String targetOperatingSystem, String resolvedAppName)
      Fails when a native app and the mobile target disagree. A non-mobile target is ignored. An unclassified local path is ignored. An unclassified bs:// app fails closed.
      Parameters:
      appReference - local path, http URL, or bs:// id
      targetOperatingSystem - targetOperatingSystem
      resolvedAppName - app name for a bs:// id; ignored for a local path that already has a suffix

    • appNameFromRecentApps

      public static String appNameFromRecentApps(String recentAppsJson, String appUrl)
      Finds the app name for appUrl in a recent-apps JSON body. No network.
      Parameters:
      recentAppsJson - array body, or an object with an apps array
      appUrl - bs:// id to match against app_url
      Returns:
      app_name, otherwise filename, otherwise blank

    • lookupAppName

      public static String lookupAppName(String appUrl, String username, String accessKey)
      Reads app_name for appUrl from BrowserStack recent apps. Uses the existing username and access key. The id and the credentials are not included in errors.
      Parameters:
      appUrl - bs:// id
      username - browserStack.userName
      accessKey - browserStack.accessKey
      Returns:
      the remote app name or filename
